name: metadata-carrier
hypothesis: A crawler that reached an og:see_also-only page either understands Open Graph or harvests any url-shaped metadata. Advertising an otherwise unlinked page through exactly one head carrier per actor separates a semantic Open Graph reader (og:see_also only) from a generic attribute miner (any content= url) from a structured-document ingester (canonical, alternate and JSON-LD as well).
